limitations: Actual renderer zero was induced in fresh headless Edge; this is not a natural reproduction in the daily profile. The original daily-profile report supplies that reproduction.
Unsized headed Edge on an inactive Windows desktop exited before exposing CDP in this lab; no pass is claimed for that startup path.

Headless restore changed window state but emitted no native bounds event. The owned-window event path is covered by a unit test; shared-control fallback cleanup and explicit-device preservation are verified in the real isolated browser.

The 22-case control suite restores its private headless window for simulated human interaction and uses --window-size=1280,900; only the actual-zero and navigation suites stay minimized throughout their background cases.
This release does not imply that already loaded daily extension or Harness code has switched versions.
